title: nitrification
intro:
The nitrification process, transforming ammonium into nitrate and nitrous oxide.
   Used by horizon component Nitrification (see 47, page 231) .
  < component (N2O fraction 0.02 [<fraction>]) >
    N2O fraction: number [<fraction>]
     Parameter (default 0.02)
     Fraction of ammonium lost as N2O.

attrs.name: N2O fraction
attrs.doc: Fraction of ammonium lost as N2O.

sections.name: soil
sections.desc:
k 10 * M / (k + M). Michaelis-Menten kinetics, with nitrification based on total
ammonium content.
